title: MIT Martin Trust Center launches Dear Dreamer AI platform for youth
excerpt: The free, AI-powered tool adapts the disciplined entrepreneurship framework for middle and high school students.
bodyHtml:
The Martin Trust Center for MIT Entrepreneurship announced the launch of Dear Dreamer, a free, AI-powered platform designed to teach entrepreneurship to middle and high school students. The project was made possible through a gift from the Frank and Eileen Foundation.

The platform adapts the disciplined entrepreneurship framework, which consists of 24 steps for starting a venture, into a digital, self-paced learning experience. It features short educational videos, interactive exercises, and personalized feedback on user ideas.

The platform was inspired by the vision of Audrey McLoghlin, the founder and CEO of apparel brand Frank and Eileen and president of the Frank and Eileen Foundation. The tool utilizes Jetpack, which is MIT’s generative AI tool trained on disciplined entrepreneurship.

According to Bill Aulet, managing director of the Martin Trust Center for MIT Entrepreneurship, the project aims to empower 50,000 young entrepreneurs by 2030.
